about_short_description.short_description: Salama is an insurance firm that offers auto, home, and health insurance policies.

product.name: Auto Takaful Insurance
product.description: Provides Shariah-compliant insurance coverage for vehicles, protecting against damages and liabilities related to automobiles.

product.name: Health Takaful Insurance
product.description: Offers Shariah-compliant health insurance plans that cover medical expenses and healthcare services for individuals and families.

product.name: Home Takaful Insurance
product.description: Delivers Shariah-compliant insurance coverage for residential properties against risks such as fire, theft, and natural disasters.

product.name: Pet Takaful Insurance
product.description: Provides Shariah-compliant insurance coverage for pets, protecting against veterinary expenses and related risks.

product.name: Travel Takaful Insurance
product.description: Offers Shariah-compliant travel insurance plans that cover risks such as trip cancellations, medical emergencies, and lost luggage.

product.name: Family Takaful Insurance
product.description: Provides Shariah-compliant life and family insurance plans that offer financial protection and savings benefits to policyholders and their dependents.
